optimizer: Both modes use separate AdamW, AMSGrad=True, weight_decay=.004, cosine alpha=.9, global gradient clip=1
training_order: For both modes identical seeded batches and exactly 75 head steps; collaborative adds 75 proxy steps
checkpoint: Lowest reconstructed validation proxy MSE among epochs 1..15; restore proxy/head together

collaborative_details.selector_phase: Update only the 33-parameter head, proxy and shared features unchanged
collaborative_details.proxy_phase: Update proxy including shared features, head unchanged; use detached cached pre-head-update reconstruction

primary_comparison: Independent Ridge validation RMSE after task SSA plus Java SRD; paired collaborative minus paired_frozen
scope: New matched control; legacy frozen runs have different optimizer/schedule/stopping and are historical references only
limits: Prediction migration, not full EEG TASK reproduction
